free_tier.stated: A clearance list posted 2026-10-16 from an acquired fleet, billed monthly with no setup fee and a 1 Gbps unmetered fair-use port: a Dual Xeon Gold 6140 at 36 cores / 72 threads with 128 GB and a 480 GB SSD on a 10 Gbps port for USD 79.99; a Dual E5-2690 at 16 cores / 32 threads with 256 GB and 4 x 300 GB SAS for USD 64.99; a Dual E5-2680 v2 at 20 cores / 40 threads with 128 GB, 16 x 600 GB SAS (9.6 TB raw) for USD 59.99; a Dual E5-2680 v2 with 128 GB and a 600 GB disk for USD 44.99; and a single E5-2450L at 8 cores with 32 GB for USD 29.99. Most configurations are limited to one or two units.

chaining: Seventy-two threads and a 10 Gbps port for USD 79.99 is USD 1.11 a thread-month, the lowest per-thread figure found, and it is the machine that makes a parallel compile or a bulk transfer finish without a cluster.
